mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as corporate cash flows gain present value.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 600 thousand units signal deteriorating consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as recession risks materialize.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when HOUST < 600, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in federal funds rate and unemployment rate signal coordinated monetary and labor market stimulus, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing with labor market improvement
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS declines and UNRATE declines (t-test p>0.05), or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 8.5%) trigger accommodative monetary policy, supporting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when UNRATE > 8.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) indicates weakening supply chain activity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days as profit expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production below 95 units (INDPRO < 95) signals severe supply disruption, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days as recession fears intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when INDPRO < 95, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts and industrial production indicate broad economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days as recession probability rises.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative when HOUST declines and INDPRO declines (t-test p>0.05), or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Low industrial production regimes (INDPRO < 95) intensify supply chain bottlenecks, reducing corporate margins and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when INDPRO < 95, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
